title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash d3e15a3cb34e… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash d3e15a3cb34e3615b12e148369ac3bcebd5566760ebbf569ec59d02505420a74 was observed three times on October 24, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was located in Poland. This indicator should be matched against files in security environments and threat intelligence feeds for detection purposes.
